# Yield

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Gives up the rest of the caller's timeslice.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x01` SVC_YIELD | — | no | 2.0 |

```c
void Yield(void);
```

**Registers:** `() -> r0 ZUZU_OK`

The caller goes to the back of its priority level and runs again once the other ready tasks at that level have had their turn. Returns at once if no other task is ready.
